_comment: EXP-1031: THE toast, identical x4 (web packages/ui/src/toast.tsx over sonner, desktop crates/ui/src/toast.rs (its own ToastLayer per window over gpui_base::ToastManager, theme::motion for every transition), iOS ExpCore ToastStack + ExpUI Toast.swift, Android domain/ToastStack.kt + ui/components/Toast.kt). The numbers are sonner 2.0.7's. A toast is one sentence (`title`), an optional `description`, an optional `action` and a `kind` whose colour sits on the ICON alone (concept icons ui-success / ui-error / ui-info / ui-warning, close = ui-close); the card is the opaque glass card fill with the card hairline at radius lg, never a shadow, `width` wide on a pointer and the phone's width minus `mobileViewportOffset` on touch. `placement`: bottom-right on a pointer (web from `touchMaxWidth` up, the IDE), `viewportOffset` from the edges; TOP-centre on touch (mobile web, iOS, Android) `mobileViewportOffset` below the status bar, so no bottom sheet, tab bar or keyboard ever covers it. On a top stack the older toasts peek out BELOW the front one and the stack grows downward when expanded; the swipe that dismisses goes up or sideways. The newest toast is in front; the older ones peek out behind it by `peek` and shrink by `scaleStep` per rank, `visible` of them at most. Hover (pointer) or tap (touch) EXPANDS the stack: every toast at full size, `gap` apart, and the auto-dismiss clock (`durationMs`) pauses. Dismiss = the close glyph, a swipe past `swipeThreshold` (touch and web), or the action. `geometry` is per item, oldest first: `offset` = the item's top inside the stack box (anchoredBottom stacks measure from the box's top too), `scale` its width factor, `visible` whether it draws at all; `height` is the stack box. Points (web px = desktop px = iOS pt = Android dp). Locked by packages/ui toast.test.tsx, crates/ui toast.rs tests, ExpCore ToastStackTests, Android ToastStackTest.

geometry.name: one toast sits at the origin
three equal toasts collapsed from the top peek by rank
three equal toasts expanded from the top lie gap apart at full size
four mixed toasts collapsed from the bottom hide the fourth
four mixed toasts expanded from the bottom stack upward gap apart
five toasts collapsed show three and keep the rest behind
